name: cvat
description: I contributed Kubernetes deployment templates and scripts to extend CVAT beyond its original single-EC2 deployment method. This enables scalable, cloud-native, and production-grade setups of CVAT on Kubernetes.

paragraphs: This repository extends the original CVAT project by introducing Kubernetes deployment templates. At the time of publication, CVAT could only be deployed on a single EC2 instance, limiting scalability and manageability.
To address this, I contributed a kubernetes-templates/ folder containing manifests and scripts that enable seamless deployment of CVAT into a Kubernetes cluster. These templates allow teams to:
This addition empowers users to move beyond single-instance setups and leverage Kubernetes for production-grade, distributed deployments of CVAT.
features: Deploy CVAT in a scalable, cloud-native environment
Simplify updates, monitoring, and resource allocation
